what: Pause checkpoint is specified to read ISSUE_NUMBER from source-env.sh via phase_driver_session_get, but that helper only recognizes bare KEY= lines while source-env.sh writes export ISSUE_NUMBER=...
scenario_or_breakage: When .pause-requested appears inside the consolidated driver, the checkpoint cannot resolve the issue and exits 2 instead of execing design-pause-save.sh, regressing the pause behavior the plan says it preserves
suggested_fix: Have the checkpoint use the already-sourced ISSUE_NUMBER when present or source the generated source-env.sh/read export ISSUE_NUMBER= grammar explicitly; update the pause harness to create source-env.sh with export ISSUE_NUMBER=... rather than a bare KEY= fixture
